answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 36034 Country: Pakistan Title: We are hiring a non-Muslim cook for out office Question: We are hiring a non-Muslim cook for out office. Please let us know if this is OK to have a non-Muslim cook if following two conditions: (1) No Muslim cook is available. (2) Muslim cooks are not as good as non-Muslim cooks with regard to experience etc. Answer ID: 36034 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 35/27/H=1433) It is allowable, but you should keep on searching any expert Muslim cook as well. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
